info.title: Parabola Trading API
info.description: Comprehensive algorithmic-trading API — 4-layer architecture (Data · Research/Backtesting · Strategy · Execution/Risk), verified wallet/JWT identity, and natural-language trading. Runs behind the Parabola pilot.

post.description:
Submit a market/limit/stop order. Runs full pre-trade risk validation
before execution. Set `dry_run: true` to preview without executing.
Dry-run: run the risk engine and return every check without executing.

Run a strategy across historical OHLCV and return a full performance
report (returns, Sharpe/Sortino, drawdown, trades, equity curve).
